description: This is a shell script used for automating the creation and deletion of a Kubernetes (K8s) cluster using kind (Kubernetes in Docker). It handles command-line arguments, detects container runtimes (docker or podman), checks prerequisites, and manages the cluster lifecycle with status messages and user guidance.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs an informational message with blue color formatting.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Outputs a success message with green color formatting.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message with yellow color formatting.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message with red color formatting and exits the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays the usage information and options for the script.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a specific container provider (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container provider (docker or podman) is responsive/running.

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects which container runtime (docker or podman) is installed and responsive.
